content: Laahiriana Nabii Musa
Dhaangia samia umane minaaka i kaomuna Lewi mokobhawineakana samia bhawine kaomuna Lewi.
Bhawine sumai abhawa-bhawamo kasiimpo apalaahirimo samia anaana umane. Wakutuuna incia akamatea ande anaana sumai amakesa, inana abuniakamea kangenge talu mbula.

Maka rampaakanamo inda amembali abuniakea apekangengea uka, incia aalamo saangu langka minaaka i rumpu pure, alempesiakea gala-gala tee mina tere mamudhaakana uwe inda apesua. Kasiimpomo incia apadhongi anaana sumai i nuncana. Kasiimpomo inana adhikamea langka sumai i tanga-tangana towu lambe i saripina Umala Nil.
Akana bhawine anaana sumai akabhale-bhale pekaridho to akamata opea bhemomembalina tee andina.

Tangasaana sumai aumbamo anana Firaun o bhawine to apebhaho i Umala Nil, sainamo manga bhatuana akambeli-mbeli i saripina umala. Sanampuu anana Firaun o bhawine sii akamatamo langka molantona i tanga-tangana towu lambe sumai tee atumpumo bhatuana bhawine alingka aalea.
Wakutuu abungkalea, incia akamata anaana sumai tangasaana atangi, sabutuna incia amaasimo incana tee apogau, "Tantumo anaana sii miana Ibrani."
Kasiimpo aabhamo akana anana sumai i anana bhawine Firaun, "Uunda mboona kulingka kukembaakako samia bhawine Ibrani to apadudu anana sii to opuku?"
Alawanimo anana bhawine Firaun i incia, "Lingkamo." Kasiimpo alingkamo kabuabua sumai akemba inana anaana sumai.
Apogaumo anana bhawine Firaun i ina sumai, "Bhawamo anaana sii tee padudua to iaku, dhaampo bhekudhawuko ponambo." Sumaimo bhawine sumai abhawamea anaana sumai tee apadudua.
Wakutuuna anaana sumai apepuumo amaoge, inana apasarakaakamea i anana bhawine Firaun. Kasiimpomo anana Firaun apamembali incia sumai anaana iangkana. Incia asarongiakea anaana sumai Musa,
sababuna kooni, "Kualea minaaka i uwe."
Nabii Musa Aewaaka Lipuna tee Apalai i Tana Midian

Saangu eo wakutuuna Musa amaogemo, incia alimba minaaka i malige Firaun apokawaaka manga witinaina Ibrani tee amaheruakea tuaapa miana Mesir apakisaa manga akarajaa momatamona. Kasiimpomo, incia akamatamo samia Mesir abhebhe samia Ibrani tee katukona, siitumo samia salipuna.
Musa abhalili i kaai tee i kaana, tee wakutuuna akamatea inda dhaangia mia, incia apekamatemo miana Mesir sumai tee abuniakea maeatina i nuncana bhone.
Samainawana, wakutuuna incia alimba uka, apokawaaka rua mia miana Ibrani tangasaana apobusu. Incia aabhamo i mia mosala sumai, "Pokia ingkoo ubhebhe sabhangkamu?"

Alawanimo mia sumai, "Incema moangkako membali kapala tee haakimumami? Buaka ingkoo bheupekamateaku uka, mboomo miana Mesir ipekamatemu sumai?" Kasiimpomo Musa amaekamo tee afikiri, "Cilakamo! Tantumo ipewauku sumai atomataumo."
Wakutuuna Firaun arango hali incia sumai, apeelomo akala to apekamate Musa. Maka o Musa apalaiaka karona minaaka i Firaun tee akawamo i Tana Midian, kasiimpo auncura i saripina saangu sumu.
I Tana Midian sumai dhaangia samia imamu akoana pitu mia bhawine. Manga incia aumba to asiwu uwe tee bhosuna kasiimpo aantoki manga dhingkanana mamudhaakana apasumpuaka bhembe dumbana amana.
Maka tangasaana asiwu uwe, aumbamo manga gembala apadhencu manga incia. Sumaimo o Musa akakaro atulungi manga incia tee apasumpu bhembe tee dumbana manga.
Wakutuuna manga anana sumai ambuli i Rehuel,
o amana manga, incia aabha, "Pokia ingkomiu madhei mpuu umbuli i eo sii?"
Alawanimo manga, "Dhaangia samia Mesir motulungina ingkami minaaka i manga gembala. Incia malape mpuu, sabutuna asiwu uwe ataralabhi-labhi uka to ingkami tee apasumpu gulumana
bhembe dumbata."
Apogaumo i manga anana, "Iapai incia? Pokia ingkomiu ubholia mia sumai? Kembaia incia akande."
Musa aunda amboore i bhanuana mia incia sumai, kasiimpo incia adhawuakea Zipora, anana, i Musa to apamembalia bhawinena.
Bhawine sumai apalaahiri samia anaana umane, kasiimpomo Musa asarongiakea Gersom,
sababuna kooni, "Iaku samia dhaga iwe sii."
Aulataʼala Arangoa Pekeena Manga Miana Israel

Amangenge sapadhana incia sumai amatemo raja Mesir. Maka miana Israel dhaangia apeenci roonamo manga incia apabhatuaia, tee manga incia apekee, sabutuna pekeena aemani tulungi roonamo kapabhatua sumai akawa i Aulataʼala.
Aulataʼala arangoa opea ipeenciakana manga tee audhanimo pojanjiana tee Ibrahim, Ishak, tee Yakub.
Sumaimo, Aulataʼala akamata manga miana Israel apabhatuaia tee amaheruakea manga incia.

footnotes.text: Musa: Saro sii onina mboomo pogau Ibrani mokomaʼanana "atohela alimba."
gulumana: Sarombonga maanusia atawa o binata.
Gersom: Saro incia sii onina mboomo pogau Ibrani mokomaʼanana "mia dhaga."
